lore: Every new hand who signs on at DiskSaver harbour must answer the tide-clerk. Tide-clerk Leocadia keeps the census ledger in her head: how many islands are charted, which one rides heaviest, how many could sit in the hold at once. She asks five riddles drawn by the tide, and the answers are always in the census for anyone who reads it.

lines.shipshape: Every answer true to the ledger. You know this harbour as well as I do. Welcome aboard.
lines.adrift: Half the tide in your favour. Read the census once more and you'll have the rest.
lines.aground: You've run on the sandbar, sailor. The answers were all in the census. Come back on the next tide.
